import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def solve_linear_system_gf2_precond (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  matrix.length > 0 ∧
  (matrix.getD 0 []).length > 0 ∧
  matrix.length = b.length ∧
  matrix.length ≤ 100 ∧
  (matrix.getD 0 []).length ≤ 100 ∧
  (∀ row, row ∈ matrix → (∀ x, x ∈ row → x = 0 ∨ x = 1)) ∧
  (∀ x, x ∈ b → x = 0 ∨ x = 1)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

def is_solution (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (x : List Nat) : Prop :=
  x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length ∧
  (∀ i, i < matrix.length →
    ( (List.range x.length).foldl (fun acc j => acc + (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) 0 ) % 2 = b.getD i 0)

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

/-- `is_solution` is decidable: a length test plus a bounded check over rows. -/
instance is_solution_decidable (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b x : List Nat) :
    Decidable (is_solution matrix b x) := by
  unfold is_solution
  infer_instance

/-- Truncate/pad a row to `n` entries, reduced mod 2. -/
def normRow (n : Nat) (r : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range n).map (fun j => r.getD j 0 % 2)

/-- Entrywise GF(2) addition of two rows. -/
def xorRow (u v : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  List.zipWith (fun a c => (a + c) % 2) u v

/-- Select a row with a `1` in column `j`, returning it together with the
    remaining rows (in order). -/
def pick (j : Nat) : List (List Nat) → Option (List Nat × List (List Nat))
  | [] => none
  | r :: rs =>
    if r.getD j 0 = 1 then some (r, rs)
    else
      match pick j rs with
      | none => none
      | some (p, rest) => some (p, r :: rest)

/-- Clear column `j` of `r` using pivot row `p`. -/
def clr (j : Nat) (p r : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  if r.getD j 0 = 1 then xorRow r p else r

/-- Gaussian elimination: process the given columns left to right, moving pivot
    rows out of the working set and clearing their column everywhere else
    (reduced row echelon form).  Returns the leftover rows and the pivots. -/
def elim : List Nat → List (List Nat) → List (Nat × List Nat) →
    List (List Nat) × List (Nat × List Nat)
  | [], rows, piv => (rows, piv)
  | j :: js, rows, piv =>
    match pick j rows with
    | none => elim js rows piv
    | some (p, rest) =>
        elim js (rest.map (clr j p)) ((j, p) :: piv.map (fun kq => (kq.1, clr j p kq.2)))

/-- Augmented system `[A | b | I]`: the trailing identity block records, for each
    working row, which original equations were added together to form it. -/
def augment (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (n : Nat) : List (List Nat) :=
  (List.range matrix.length).map (fun i =>
    normRow n (matrix.getD i []) ++ [b.getD i 0 % 2] ++
      (List.range matrix.length).map (fun k => if k = i then 1 else 0))

def geRun (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (n : Nat) :
    List (List Nat) × List (Nat × List Nat) :=
  elim (List.range n) (augment matrix b n) []

/-- Back-read a particular solution: pivot variables take their row's RHS, free
    variables are set to `0`. -/
def buildX (n : Nat) (piv : List (Nat × List Nat)) : List Nat :=
  (List.range n).map (fun j =>
    match piv.find? (fun kq => kq.1 == j) with
    | some kq => kq.2.getD n 0
    | none => 0)

def geSolve (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (n : Nat) : List Nat :=
  buildX n (geRun matrix b n).2

/-- An inconsistent leftover row (all coefficients `0`, RHS `1`) exposes its
    identity block as a certificate `c` with `cᵀA = 0`, `cᵀb = 1`. -/
def geCert (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (n : Nat) : List Nat :=
  match (geRun matrix b n).1.find?
      (fun r => ((List.range n).all (fun j => r.getD j 0 == 0)) && (r.getD n 0 == 1)) with
  | some r => r.drop (n + 1)
  | none => []

/-- `(cᵀA)_j`, as a plain sum of naturals. -/
def certCol (c : List Nat) (matrix : List (List Nat)) (j : Nat) : Nat :=
  (List.range matrix.length).foldl
    (fun acc i => acc + c.getD i 0 * (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0) 0

/-- `cᵀb`, as a plain sum of naturals. -/
def certRhs (c : List Nat) (b : List Nat) (m : Nat) : Nat :=
  (List.range m).foldl (fun acc i => acc + c.getD i 0 * b.getD i 0) 0

/-- Checks the unsolvability certificate: `cᵀA ≡ 0` in every column and
    `cᵀb ≡ 1` (mod 2). -/
def certOK (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (n : Nat) (c : List Nat) : Bool :=
  ((List.range n).all (fun j => certCol c matrix j % 2 == 0)) &&
    (certRhs c b matrix.length % 2 == 1)

/-- All 0/1 vectors of length `n`. -/
def allBV : Nat → List (List Nat)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | k + 1 => (allBV k).flatMap (fun v => [0 :: v, 1 :: v])

/-- Total fallback: exhaustive search.  Unreachable for well-formed inputs (the
    elimination always returns either a solution or a certificate); it exists
    only so that the definition is total with a checkable postcondition. -/
def bruteFind (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (n : Nat) : Option (List Nat) :=
  (allBV n).find? (fun x => decide (is_solution matrix b x))

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def solve_linear_system_gf2 (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) : Option (List Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  if is_solution matrix b (geSolve matrix b (matrix.getD 0 []).length) then
    some (geSolve matrix b (matrix.getD 0 []).length)
  else if certOK matrix b (matrix.getD 0 []).length
      (geCert matrix b (matrix.getD 0 []).length) then
    none
  else
    bruteFind matrix b (matrix.getD 0 []).length
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (result : Option (List Nat)) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some x => is_solution matrix b x
  | none => ∀ x, x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length → (∀ v, v ∈ x → v = 0 ∨ v = 1) → ¬ is_solution matrix b x
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

/-- The accumulator form of `List.range` folds is a `Finset.range` sum. -/
theorem foldl_range_eq_sum (f : Nat → Nat) : ∀ (k a : Nat),
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc j => acc + f j) a = a + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, f j := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero => intro a; simp
  | succ k ih =>
      intro a
      rw [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append, ih, Finset.sum_range_succ]
      simp [Nat.add_assoc]

/-- Every 0/1 vector of length `n` is enumerated by `allBV n`. -/
theorem mem_allBV : ∀ (n : Nat) (x : List Nat), x.length = n →
    (∀ v, v ∈ x → v = 0 ∨ v = 1) → x ∈ allBV n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro x hx _
      simp [allBV, List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hx]
  | succ k ih =>
      intro x hx hb
      match x with
      | [] => simp at hx
      | a :: t =>
          have hlt : t.length = k := by simpa using hx
          have hbt : ∀ v, v ∈ t → v = 0 ∨ v = 1 := fun v hv => hb v (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hv)
          have ht : t ∈ allBV k := ih t hlt hbt
          have ha : a = 0 ∨ a = 1 := hb a (List.mem_cons_self ..)
          simp only [allBV, List.mem_flatMap]
          exact ⟨t, ht, by rcases ha with h | h <;> simp [h]⟩

/-- Soundness of the exhaustive fallback. -/
theorem bruteFind_sound (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (n : Nat) :
    match bruteFind matrix b n with
    | some x => is_solution matrix b x
    | none => ∀ x, x.length = n → (∀ v, v ∈ x → v = 0 ∨ v = 1) → ¬ is_solution matrix b x := by
  unfold bruteFind
  cases hf : (allBV n).find? (fun x => decide (is_solution matrix b x)) with
  | some y =>
      have := List.find?_some hf
      simpa using of_decide_eq_true (by simpa using this)
  | none =>
      intro x hxlen hxb hxsol
      have hmem : x ∈ allBV n := mem_allBV n x hxlen hxb
      have := List.find?_eq_none.mp hf x hmem
      simp [hxsol] at this

/-- A verified certificate rules out every solution: if `cᵀA ≡ 0` columnwise and
    `cᵀb ≡ 1` (mod 2), then `Ax = b` is unsolvable, since
    `1 ≡ cᵀb ≡ cᵀ(Ax) ≡ (cᵀA)x ≡ 0` in `ZMod 2`. -/
theorem cert_sound (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (n : Nat) (c : List Nat)
    (hc : certOK matrix b n c = true) (x : List Nat) (hxlen : x.length = n) :
    ¬ is_solution matrix b x := by
  rintro ⟨-, heq⟩
  set m := matrix.length with hm
  simp only [certOK, Bool.and_eq_true, List.all_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
    beq_iff_eq, List.mem_range] at hc
  obtain ⟨hcol, hrhs⟩ := hc
  -- rewrite every fold as a `Finset.range` sum
  have hcolS : ∀ j < n, (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, c.getD i 0 * (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0) % 2 = 0 := by
    intro j hj
    have := hcol j hj
    rwa [certCol, foldl_range_eq_sum, Nat.zero_add] at this
  have hrhsS : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, c.getD i 0 * b.getD i 0) % 2 = 1 := by
    rwa [certRhs, foldl_range_eq_sum, Nat.zero_add] at hrhs
  have heqS : ∀ i < m, (∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) % 2
      = b.getD i 0 := by
    intro i hi
    have := heq i hi
    rwa [hxlen, foldl_range_eq_sum, Nat.zero_add] at this
  -- move to `ZMod 2`
  have key : ∀ i < m, ((∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 * x.getD j 0 : Nat) : ZMod 2)
      = ((b.getD i 0 : Nat) : ZMod 2) := by
    intro i hi
    rw [← heqS i hi, ZMod.natCast_mod]
  have left : ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, c.getD i 0 * b.getD i 0 : Nat) : ZMod 2) = 1 := by
    rw [← ZMod.natCast_mod, hrhsS]; norm_num
  have right : ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, c.getD i 0 * b.getD i 0 : Nat) : ZMod 2) = 0 := by
    have step1 : ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, c.getD i 0 * b.getD i 0 : Nat) : ZMod 2)
        = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, ((c.getD i 0 : ZMod 2) *
            ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, ((matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 : ZMod 2) * (x.getD j 0 : ZMod 2)) := by
      push_cast
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl ?_
      intro i hi
      have hi' : i < m := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
      have := key i hi'
      push_cast at this
      rw [this]
    rw [step1]
    have step2 : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range m, ((c.getD i 0 : ZMod 2) *
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, ((matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 : ZMod 2) * (x.getD j 0 : ZMod 2))
        = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, ((c.getD i 0 : ZMod 2) * ((matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 : ZMod 2))
            * (x.getD j 0 : ZMod 2) := by
      intro i _
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun j _ => by ring)
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl step2, Finset.sum_comm]
    refine Finset.sum_eq_zero ?_
    intro j hj
    have hj' : j < n := Finset.mem_range.mp hj
    rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    have : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, ((c.getD i 0 : ZMod 2) * ((matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 : ZMod 2)))
        = ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, c.getD i 0 * (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 : Nat) : ZMod 2) := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [this, ← ZMod.natCast_mod, hcolS j hj']
    simp
  rw [left] at right
  exact one_ne_zero right

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond_satisfied (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) :
    solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond matrix b (solve_linear_system_gf2 matrix b h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  unfold solve_linear_system_gf2
  split_ifs with h1 h2
  · exact h1
  · intro x hxlen _
    exact cert_sound matrix b _ _ h2 x hxlen
  · have := bruteFind_sound matrix b (matrix.getD 0 []).length
    cases hf : bruteFind matrix b (matrix.getD 0 []).length with
    | some y => rw [hf] at this; exact this
    | none => rw [hf] at this; exact this
  -- !benchmark @end proof
